description: Free: lists the addresses of a public site from its robots.txt sitemaps, /sitemap.xml and the links on the page given. No key, nothing extracted or charged. Use it to find the pages to fetch. Example: {"url":"https://example.com/","search":"/docs/"}.

search.description: Optional: only addresses containing this text, for example "/docs/".

url.description: Any page on the site, usually its home page, for example https://example.com/.

name: proof_fetch_map
title: List a site's pages (free)
